What to find: Methods of distribution (open weights on repositories, API, cloud platforms, apps).

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Model weights are released openly (Meta is "openly releasing these models"). Scout is released as BF16 weights, with code for on-the-fly int4 quantization. Quantized checkpoints are also provided. Usable via the Hugging Face transformers library (model_id meta-llama/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct). The card does not describe API, cloud platform or app distribution.
quotes: Since Meta is openly releasing these models, the training energy use and greenhouse gas emissions will not be incurred by others.
The Llama 4 Scout model is released as BF16 weights, but can fit within a single H100 GPU with on-the-fly int4 quantization
We've provided quantized checkpoints for deployment flexibility, but all reported evaluations and testing were conducted on bf16 models.
